observation.visible_scene: A backyard setting with a toy roller-coaster track (Hot Wheels style) built on a long sloped wooden plank. The track has a series of red vertical loops that decrease in diameter from the high left end down to the low right end, joined by black rails with yellow and white connector pieces. Background elements include a tan house wall with a sconce light, white-framed sliding glass doors, a stainless grill, a maroon couch, a small banana plant, a wooden fence, and green lawn. A strip of gray tape marks the joint in the plank. No vehicle is present on the track at any point in the excerpt.
visible_changes: The track, its loops, the connectors, and every background object (doors, grill, couch, plant, fence, tape) keep a constant shape and constant relative positions to one another throughout the segment; there is no object motion, no deformation, and no car traveling the track.

The only change is the camera viewpoint: the framing of the scene shifts gradually from frame to frame, altering how much of the large left loop is shown and where the right-side doors sit in the frame, so the apparent angle and scale of the plank and loops drift slowly (a continuous camera pan/track with slight zoom), not a physical change in the setup.
The motion is continuous across the sampled frames with no visible editing cut inside the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether a car is launched onto the track before the first frame or after the last frame (none is visible within the segment).
The full extent of the track above the high end and below the low end, which is cropped out.
Whether the camera movement is handheld panning, a zoom, or a combination, and its exact direction/speed.
uncertain_details: The precise direction and magnitude of the camera shift (objects drift across the frame, but the exact pan/zoom relationship is hard to pin down from the samples).
Any very small vibration or wobble of the plank is not distinguishable from camera shake.
